items.escena: A clay office worker looking at a tall stack of sealed paper envelopes and pulling out the one with a single bright coloured band across its front, the others plain
A clay student in a neat school uniform nodding respectfully and offering a handshake to an older professor in a school corridor
A clay student walking straight up to a library counter and holding out a borrowed book to return it, getting directly to the point
A clay student on a kitchen counter assembling a sandwich: the top and bottom slices of bread are ready, and she layers lettuce, tomato and cheese in the middle
A clay student at a reception desk smiling and placing a hand on her heart to thank the receptionist, turning politely to leave
A clay young man in a jacket giving a polite wave and a slight bow as he leaves an office, holding the door open behind him
A clay hand at the bottom of a cream paper sheet drawing a swirling loop of blue ink with a fountain pen
A clay student sitting at a desk by a sunny window writing with a pen on cream paper, an empty envelope waiting beside her

items.texto: I would like to... / I would appreciate it if...
items.escena: A clay student politely holding out an empty folder with both hands toward a librarian at a counter, with a hopeful, courteous smile
A clay hand fastening a small photograph to a paper sheet with a large shiny paper clip, ready to slide both into an envelope
A clay student committee showing a small model of a school garden on a table to the principal, one student gesturing toward it with an open hand

items.texto: I look forward to hearing from you.
items.escena: A clay young woman sitting on her front steps, leaning forward hopefully as the mail carrier with a shoulder bag walks up the street toward her house
A clay receptionist in a quiet office welcoming a visitor in a suit, holding out a hand in a courteous, formal greeting
